title: THE 21-CM-EPOCH FACE: the phantom at reionization -- the high-z 21-cm power spectrum's framework signature vs CDM
question: (1) the epoch state -- the pre-condensation state restated honestly (absent, not hot: occupation e^-6.44e6; the existence ladder over the 21-cm window; reionization mostly complete at z* = 2.4); (2) the 21-cm prediction -- the dark-ages brightness temperature NOT CDM-free / phantom-free, the bias-1 baryon-locked power, the difference spectrum vs CDM at z ~ 3-10; (3) the armed probe -- the SKA-era 21-cm power (UNVERIFIED), the discriminator, the k/epoch window, the pre-registered test; (4) verdicts V1-V3

part1_epoch_state.reionization_status_at_zstar: mostly complete: z* = 2.43 << the EoR completion z ~ 6 (Planck tau_e = 0.0544 +- 0.0073, h73); x_HI(z*) ~ 0

verdicts.V1: THE PRE-CONDENSATION STATE, RESTATED HONESTLY (V1): at z > z*, the galaxy-class equilibrium does NOT exist -- and the honest mechanics is ABSENCE, not a 'suppressing-hot phase': a hot phase would be a thermal gas, and the Boltzmann occupation of the 5.09 keV species is e^-6.44e6 = 10^(-2.80e6) at T_b (B07) and below 10^(-1e5) at EVERY 21-cm epoch (C2: the worst case, z = 100, log10 = -2e+06): no phantom gas waits.  The equilibrium forms WHEN the local temperature falls to T_b (T_CMB(z*) = T_b, z* = 2.426, inside the committed [2.3656, 2.4932] band) -- and for the galaxy class that happened in a REIONIZED universe (z* << the EoR completion z ~ 6; Planck tau_e = 0.0544 +- 0.0073, h73): 'the phantom at reionization' is, for the 21-cm-relevant class, NOT at reionization.  The pre-z* dark sector IS the free dust (G079: dust share 0.9921, functionally CDM) -- the honest meaning of 'THE DARK SECTOR DOES NOT EXIST as a structure before z*' is: the NOVEL equilibrium component does not exist; the CDM-like dust does.  THE LADDER (environment-set, G213): cluster z* = 86-236 (the dark ages), group z* ~ 14 (the EoR itself), galaxy z* = 2.43 (post-EoR) -- the class that dominates the 21-cm power is ABSENT through the whole window (Theta = 0, C3); below the freeze floor (65 km/s <-> M_b ~ 5.7e+09 Msun) z* < 0 and the equilibrium never condenses in the minihalos.
verdicts.V2: THE 21-CM PREDICTION (V2).  (a) THE DARK AGES: at z ~ 30, the 21-cm brightness temperature is NOT CDM-free -- it is baryonic physics plus the CDM-like free dust, identical to CDM's (T_0(30) = 49.12 mK, the standard scaling, UNVERIFIED): the framework's dark ages are PHANTOM-FREE (no gas, no wells), not CDM-free.  (b) THE DISTINCTIVE PREDICTION: the 21-cm power spectrum's evolution TRACKS the baryonic structure formation with bias 1 -- the phantom condenses AT the baryonic structures when T_CMB = T_b and is baryon-locked by construction (M_ph(<r_M) = M_b, D06 C7): it never precedes the baryons, it never dark-first collapses.  (c) THE DIFFERENCE SPECTRUM at z ~ 3-10: Delta P_21/P_21 = b_halo(M, z)^2 - 1 -- the CDM dark-first excess over the framework's baryon-locked floor: +582% at (1e10, z = 5), +7091% at (1e11, z = 8), the mass-function-weighted tracer opening from +214% at z = 3 to +1558% at z = 9 (Part 2.3): the epochs z ~ 3-10 are where theory and CDM separate by a factor 2-100 in the 21-cm power.  (d) THE 'ABSORPTION AT THE TURN-ON' ADJUDICATED: the phantom has no 21-cm coupling and no gas, and its turn-on is post-EoR: the framework predicts NO 21-cm absorption from the phantom (T4 kill); the turn-on's imprint is the gravitational step M_tot/M_b: 1 -> 2 at r_M at z* = 2.4 (vs CDM's 6-30x wells assembled dark-first).
verdicts.V3: THE HONEST STATEMENT (V3): THE FRAMEWORK'S DARK AGES -- the phantom is absent before z* = 2.4: no phantom gas waits (occupation 10^(-2.80e6), B07), the equilibrium exists only where and when T_CMB < T_b, and the galaxy class -- the class that drives the 21-cm power -- condensed at z* = 2.426, BELOW the entire 21-cm-observable window, in an already-reionized universe.  The 21-cm power is baryon-locked from the turn-on with bias 1 (the equilibrium of the baryonic well), and the SKA-era 21-cm power spectrum is the registered discriminator between the equilibrium and CDM's dark-first structure: at k ~ 0.5-5 Mpc^-1, z ~ 3-10, CDM's dark-first template exceeds the baryon-locked floor by a factor 2-100 (b_halo^2 - 1 = +100% to +10000%), and a floor measurement (T2) would be a strong statement about the equilibrium's epoch.  THE HONEST CONFOUNDERS, all registered: (1) the free dust (99.2% of the cosmic budget, CDM-like, G079) can carry a dark-first excess -- a T1 excess constrains the dust/hierarchical balance, only a T2 floor is a hard framework statement; (2) the smooth IGM density term has bias ~ 1 in both doxai -- the separation lives in the source/HI-tracer terms; (3) the x_HI/T_s astrophysical systematics control the amplitude -- the signed prediction is the epoch-dependent SHAPE (opening at z >= 5); (4) no EoR 21-cm power detection exists and the SKA sensitivity is UNVERIFIED.  Consistency: the committed S3-29 non-prediction (no linear 21-cm signature at z = 17-35) is respected -- G05's face is the EoR/post-EoR baryon-locking, not a cosmic-dawn signature.  THE ONE-LINE VERDICT: the framework's 21-cm-epoch face is the ABSENCE of the phantom through reionization, its baryon-locked arrival at z* = 2.4, and the floor-and-shape discriminator between the equilibrium and CDM's dark-first collapse -- registered, armed, unfired.
